title: sccap record index line
description: One line of index.jsonl. DERIVED DATA: fully regenerable from the pcapng segments via `sccap index --rebuild`. A missing, truncated or corrupt index never invalidates a session. A truncated final line after abrupt termination is expected and detected on parse.

t_mono.description: Nanoseconds since session start, from CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Survives a wall-clock step (FR-003).

frames.description: The pcapng frames this record spans — the link back to evidence. A record that cannot cite its frames is a bug, not a record.

segment.description: pcapng segment filename. Frame references are (segment, index) rather than globally numbered, so a lost segment does not invalidate references into the others.

index.description: Zero-based frame index within that segment.

byte_len.description: Length in bytes of the protocol-level unit (datagram, or one framed message on a reassembled stream).

decode.description: Interpretation of the record. null means decode was not attempted (e.g. --no-decode). Never a substitute for the bytes.

status.description: decoded = type and body understood. undecoded = element recognised, body layout unknown. unknown_element = opcode/type absent from the known universe, flagged as novel (FR-023). failed = decoder errored or panicked; contained, capture unaffected (FR-016).

element.description: Sub-type name: an AC_* opcode or SN_* notification type (FR-015).

fields.description: Decoded fields. Present only when status is 'decoded'. A partial interpretation is never presented as complete — anything short of a full decode is 'undecoded' (FR-017).

novel.description: Element is unknown to this build's element universe. Surfaced to the contributor during capture (FR-023).

decoder_version.description: Which decoder produced this result. Lets a re-decode years later be compared against what was recorded at capture time (FR-030, SC-007).

annotation_seq.description: Marker sequence nearest this record, when a contributor or derived annotation applies (FR-018, FR-019).
